purpose: This table provides cleaned, typed hourly weather observations for the three NYC-area airports (EWR, JFK, LGA) for downstream flight-delay and operations analysis.
usage: Consumers should join on origin and time_hour to align weather with flight records; wind_gust and pressure carry substantial nulls (74.6% and 11.5% respectively) and must be handled explicitly (e.g. coalesce or filter) rather than assumed populated, and wind_dir has a small null rate (1.7%) from missing calm-wind readings.
limitations: Cleanup did not impute any null values; wind_gust remains sparsely populated (74.6% null) and pressure (11.5% null) and wind_dir (1.7%) and wind_speed (0.02%) retain their original null patterns from bronze. No duplicate rows were found (duplicate_row_rate 0.0), so no dedupe logic was applied, and the declared grain (origin, time_hour) has not been measured for uniqueness in the warehouse and should be validated before reliance.
